# Android SMAPI source provenance

- Source repository: `https://github.com/NRTnarathip/SMAPI-Android-1.6`
- Imported commit: `6a34bbeb6e891536cdd948594094482ba0d8d264`
- Fork version: `4.3.2.5`
- Imported on: `2026-07-26`
- License: GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0

The imported snapshot contains only the SMAPI runtime, Toolkit, CoreInterfaces,
shared internal sources, translations, and the bundled metadata/blacklist files.
It intentionally excludes SMAPILoader and all commercial game binaries.

JunimoGate-specific changes are summarized in
`patches/smapi-android/series.md`.
